note.en: Native RGB-D depth is measured; zero denotes missing returns. Rendered ERP derivatives have their own definitions and masks.
note.zh: 原始 RGB-D 深度来自测量，零值为缺失；渲染 ERP 派生集采用各自的定义与掩码。

note.en: Registered camera-to-world poses are provided for static scan views, not a continuous tracked motion sequence.
note.zh: 提供静态扫描视图的配准相机位姿，并非连续运动的独立跟踪轨迹。

note.en: Perspective and panoramic depths are rendered from real scanned geometry; preserve projection-specific depth definitions and invalid masks.
note.zh: 透视与全景深度由实扫几何渲染；需保留不同投影的深度定义及无效掩码。

note.en: Per-view registered camera metadata is released; these scan viewpoints do not constitute a continuous motion trajectory.
note.zh: 提供逐视图配准相机元数据；这些扫描视点并不构成连续运动轨迹。

note.en: Synthetic scenes provide rendered depth with camera metadata and geometric validity constraints.
note.zh: 合成场景提供渲染深度、相机元数据及几何有效性约束。

note.en: Camera positions and orientations accompany rendered views; the release is a scene/view benchmark rather than a continuous odometry sequence.
note.zh: 渲染视图附有相机位置与方向；该发布以场景和视图为单位，并非连续里程计序列。

note.en: Depth can be rendered from the released reconstructed meshes. The chosen renderer/export determines scale, clipping and validity.
note.zh: 可由发布的重建网格渲染深度；尺度、截断及有效性由所用渲染器和导出协议决定。

note.en: Simulator camera poses are known for generated trajectories. The asset release does not prescribe one fixed trajectory set.
note.zh: 生成轨迹的仿真相机位姿已知；原始资产发布不规定统一的固定轨迹集。

note.en: Rendered depth_meters stores Euclidean ray distance in metres; use finite geometry masks.
note.zh: 渲染的 depth_meters 存储米制射线距离，需使用有限值与几何有效掩码。

note.en: Rendered camera trajectories and intrinsics are provided; convert asset coordinates using meters_per_asset_unit.
note.zh: 提供渲染相机轨迹与内参；资产坐标需通过 meters_per_asset_unit 转换为米。

note.en: Rendered panoramic depth is supplied; infinite values denote holes and source-scene geometry can be incomplete.
note.zh: 提供渲染全景深度；无穷值表示空洞，源场景几何也可能不完整。

note.en: Controlled centre/right/up stereo viewpoint offsets are available, rather than a continuous physical motion trajectory.
note.zh: 提供受控的中心、右侧和上方立体视点偏移，并非连续的物理运动轨迹。

note.en: ERP depth and normals are rendered from Matterport3D/GibsonV2 geometry; preserve the renderer masks.
note.zh: ERP 深度与法线由 Matterport3D/GibsonV2 几何渲染，需保留渲染器掩码。

note.en: The documented benchmark provides independent rendered panoramas, depth and normals, not a released continuous trajectory benchmark.
note.zh: 已记录的基准提供独立渲染全景、深度和法线，并未发布连续轨迹评测序列。

note.en: Simulator depth can be rendered from reconstructed geometry; format and masks depend on the selected simulator or derivative.
note.zh: 可由重建几何渲染仿真深度；格式与掩码取决于所用仿真器或派生版本。

note.en: Generated simulator trajectories have known poses; the static scene assets alone do not define a fixed recorded trajectory set.
note.zh: 生成的仿真轨迹位姿已知；静态场景资产本身不定义固定的记录轨迹集。

note.en: The release contains scene scans, not fixed image/depth pairs. Depth supervision requires an explicitly specified simulator export.
note.zh: 发布内容是场景扫描而非固定图像—深度对；深度监督需要明确指定仿真器导出协议。

note.en: A generated simulator sequence can have known poses, but continuous trajectory files are not an intrinsic product of this asset release.
note.zh: 生成的仿真序列可具有已知位姿，但连续轨迹文件并非该资产发布的固有产品。

note.en: Laser-derived image depth and validity masks are released; valid return masks remain necessary.
note.zh: 发布激光测量生成的图像深度及有效掩码，评测仍须使用有效回波掩码。

note.en: The release is a static RGB/depth benchmark with scanner-derived views, not a continuous trajectory benchmark.
note.zh: 该发布是由扫描仪视图构成的静态 RGB/深度基准，并非连续轨迹基准。

note.en: Raw measured Kinect depth and inpainted depth are both provided. Filled pixels are processed supervision, not extra measurements.
note.zh: 同时提供 Kinect 原始实测深度与填补深度；填补像素属于处理后的监督，并非新增测量。

note.en: The documented release does not supply an independent camera trajectory reference; accelerometer readings alone are not pose truth.
note.zh: 已记录的发布不提供独立相机轨迹参考；仅有加速度计读数不等于位姿真值。

note.en: Accumulated LiDAR depth targets and sparse input depth are provided. Targets remain sparse and require official masks.
note.zh: 提供累积 LiDAR 深度目标与稀疏输入深度；目标仍然稀疏，需使用官方掩码。

note.en: This depth challenge release does not itself provide an odometry trajectory benchmark; related KITTI raw/odometry products are separate.
note.zh: 该深度挑战发布本身不提供里程计轨迹基准；相关 KITTI raw/odometry 产品另行提供。

note.en: The current release inventory lists semantic/motion labels, not supervised image-depth targets; LiDAR/dGPS material remains planned.
note.zh: 当前发布目录列出语义、运动等标签，未提供图像深度监督目标；LiDAR/dGPS 材料仍属计划内容。

note.en: The released previous images, calibration and CAN data do not include a verified independent trajectory ground-truth product.
note.zh: 已发布的前帧、标定和 CAN 数据不包含经确认的独立轨迹真值产品。

note.en: CARLA-generated panoramic depth and stereo disparity targets are released; they are different target quantities.
note.zh: 发布 CARLA 生成的全景深度与立体视差目标，两者是不同的监督量。

note.en: Synthetic camera placement and stereo baselines are documented; a downloadable continuous trajectory annotation product was not established.
note.zh: 已记录仿真相机布置与立体基线，但尚未确认可下载的连续轨迹标注产品。

note.en: ToF radial depth is released with zero marking missing pixels; bottom blind regions require masking.
note.zh: 发布 ToF 径向深度，零值表示缺失像素；底部盲区需遮罩。

note.en: The released static panoramic depth collection does not include an independent continuous camera trajectory reference.
note.zh: 该静态全景深度集合不包含独立连续相机轨迹参考。

note.en: Both point-cloud depth and mesh depth are released. LiDAR-supported pixels differ from reconstructed or hole-filled mesh supervision.
note.zh: 同时发布点云深度与网格深度；LiDAR 支撑像素与重建、补洞网格监督须区分。

note.en: Continuous camera references are refined through LiDAR/SLAM and bundle adjustment, not independently measured by motion capture.
note.zh: 连续相机参考通过 LiDAR/SLAM 与束调整细化，并非独立动作捕捉测量。

note.en: The release provides a surveyed structure scan, not per-frame image-depth annotations; stereo images alone are not depth truth.
note.zh: 发布中有测绘结构扫描，但无逐帧图像深度标注；双目图像本身不等于深度真值。

note.en: Vicon 6DoF poses or Leica 3D positions provide measured references, depending on sequence; do not infer every orientation from laser positions.
note.zh: 按序列提供 Vicon 六自由度位姿或 Leica 三维位置测量；不可从激光位置推断每个方向量均被独立观测。

note.en: Registered Kinect depth images are measured, noisy and incomplete; zero is invalid.
note.zh: 配准后的 Kinect 深度来自测量，具有噪声与空洞；零值无效。

note.en: Motion-capture pose trajectories are provided with timestamps; associate RGB/depth/pose streams explicitly.
note.zh: 提供带时间戳的动作捕捉位姿轨迹，需明确关联 RGB、深度与位姿流。

note.en: The official VIO release provides cameras and IMU without image-depth ground-truth targets.
note.zh: 官方 VIO 发布提供相机与 IMU，不提供图像深度真值目标。

note.en: Room sequences have full mocap coverage; corridor, magistrale, outdoors and slides sequences have start/end references only.
note.zh: Room 序列具有完整动捕；corridor、magistrale、outdoors 和 slides 序列仅覆盖起止片段。

note.en: Raw Velodyne ranges and sensor calibration allow sparse image-depth projection; these are not native dense depth maps.
note.zh: 原始 Velodyne 测距与传感器标定可生成稀疏图像深度投影，并非原生稠密深度图。

note.en: Metric GPS/OXTS-based trajectories are public for 00–10; 11–21 references are withheld for server evaluation.
note.zh: 00–10 公开基于 GPS/OXTS 的米制轨迹；11–21 的参考轨迹由服务器保留评测。

note.en: Calibrated LiDAR scans provide sparse measured depth after projection; occlusion and scan timing must be handled.
note.zh: 标定后的 LiDAR 扫描经投影可提供稀疏实测深度，需处理遮挡与扫描时序。

note.en: Georegistered metric poses are optimized with SfM, GPS and LiDAR constraints; some slow-motion frames lack poses.
note.zh: 地理配准米制位姿由 SfM、GPS 和 LiDAR 约束优化获得；部分慢速运动帧缺少位姿。

note.en: Simulator depth and resampled range are supplied; raw pinhole Z and customized ray-distance products must be distinguished.
note.zh: 提供仿真深度与重采样距离；须区分原始针孔 Z 深度和自定义射线距离产品。

note.en: Simulator camera-to-world pose trajectories are available; transformed camera views share the same underlying motion.
note.zh: 提供仿真相机到世界位姿轨迹；变换后的相机视图共享底层运动。

note.en: Calibrated LiDAR scans provide sparse measured ranges for projection, not complete dense image-depth targets.
note.zh: 标定后的 LiDAR 扫描提供可投影的稀疏实测距离，并非完整稠密图像深度目标。

note.en: Most sequences have sparse surveyed 3DoF positions; selected lab/arena recordings have OptiTrack 6DoF coverage.
note.zh: 多数序列具有稀疏测绘三自由度位置；部分实验室、场地记录具有 OptiTrack 六自由度覆盖。

note.en: Calibrated Hesai LiDAR supplies sparse measured ranges that can be projected; no native dense depth target is implied.
note.zh: 标定后的 Hesai LiDAR 提供可投影稀疏实测距离，不代表具有原生稠密深度目标。

note.en: Challenge references are sparse surveyed positions; selected additional sequences supply denser 6DoF references.
note.zh: 挑战参考主要是稀疏测绘位置；部分附加序列提供较稠密六自由度参考。

note.en: The released bags contain dual-fisheye images and IMU, without reference LiDAR or image-depth targets.
note.zh: 发布的包包含双鱼眼图像与 IMU，不包含参考 LiDAR 或图像深度目标。

note.en: LiDAR-inertial SLAM yields cam0-in-map reference poses. These are estimates rather than independent mocap/total-station truth; the first five seconds lack coverage.
note.zh: LiDAR 惯性 SLAM 生成 cam0 在地图中的参考位姿；属于估计参考而非独立动捕、全站仪真值，前约五秒缺少覆盖。

note.en: Released LiDAR ranges support sparse depth projection with the version-specific calibration; they are not dense per-pixel targets.
note.zh: 发布的 LiDAR 距离结合对应版本标定可生成稀疏深度投影，并非稠密逐像素目标。

note.en: ICP registration to a surveyed Leica map supplies map-derived pose references, not independent motion capture.
note.zh: 通过 ICP 对齐 Leica 测绘地图获得地图派生位姿参考，并非独立动作捕捉。

note.en: LiDAR measurements and calibration support sparse image-depth projection; they do not provide native dense depth maps.
note.zh: LiDAR 测量与标定可用于稀疏图像深度投影，不提供原生稠密深度图。

note.en: Use the separate RTK release and its validity flags; original GPS/INS quality varies, while vo.csv is an estimated drifting reference, not pose truth.
note.zh: 应使用单独 RTK 发布及其有效标记；原始 GPS/INS 质量不一，而 vo.csv 是会漂移的估计参考，并非位姿真值。

note.en: The released localization products document images and pose references, not an image-depth annotation benchmark; mapping LiDAR alone is insufficient evidence.
note.zh: 发布的定位产品记录图像和位姿参考，并非图像深度标注基准；仅有建图 LiDAR 不能证明提供深度标签。

note.en: Image/LiDAR mapping generates metric 6DoF reference poses for localization queries; independent continuous motion tracking is not established.
note.zh: 图像与 LiDAR 建图生成定位查询的米制六自由度参考位姿，未建立独立连续运动跟踪真值。

note.en: Official products are panoramas, query poses and scene point clouds. A complete image-depth annotation release is not listed.
note.zh: 官方产品为全景、查询位姿和场景点云，未列出完整图像深度标注发布。

note.en: COLMAP/OpenMVG SfM poses are manually aligned to Matterport scans, with invalid estimates manually removed. These are estimated localization references, not independent motion tracking.
note.zh: COLMAP/OpenMVG SfM 位姿手动对齐到 Matterport 扫描，并人工剔除无效估计；属于估计定位参考，而非独立运动跟踪。

note.en: The documented release inventory lists camera streams, IMU, calibration and RTK trajectories, without image-depth targets.
note.zh: 已记录发布目录列出相机流、IMU、标定及 RTK 轨迹，不含图像深度目标。

note.en: Official README announces 5 Hz RTK trajectories, but linked archive contents, position/orientation coverage and frame transforms have not been validated.
note.zh: 官方 README 声明有 5 Hz RTK 轨迹，但链接归档内容、位置与方向覆盖及坐标变换尚未验证。

note.en: Digital-twin-rendered Z-depth is provided in millimetres; choose the matching body-occlusion variant. It is not a physical depth-sensor measurement.
note.zh: 提供数字孪生渲染的毫米制 Z 深度；应选取匹配的人体遮挡版本，并非物理深度传感器测量。

note.en: The ADT ground-truth system supplies aria_trajectory.csv. MPS open/closed-loop trajectories remain separate estimates and must not replace that reference.
note.zh: ADT 真值系统提供 aria_trajectory.csv；MPS 开闭环轨迹仍是独立估计，不可替代该参考。

note.en: Laser scans and extrinsic calibration allow sparse depth supervision after projection; they are not complete image-depth targets.
note.zh: 激光扫描及外参标定经投影可提供稀疏深度监督，并非完整图像深度目标。

note.en: OptiTrack tracks a rigid marker body with calibrated sensor transforms. The outdoor large loop leaves the mocap volume, so full-route coverage is absent.
note.zh: OptiTrack 跟踪带传感器外参的刚性标记体；室外大回环离开动捕空间，因而缺少全程覆盖。

note.en: An official script projects calibrated LiDAR into cameras to form sparse depth; millimetre-accuracy TLS maps are a separate geometry reference.
note.zh: 官方脚本将标定 LiDAR 投影为相机稀疏深度；毫米精度 TLS 地图是另一类几何参考。

note.en: Core-sequence LiDAR poses are registered to the surveyed map; references are map-derived and not available for every sequence.
note.zh: 核心序列 LiDAR 位姿配准至测绘地图；参考由地图派生，并非每个序列均提供。

note.en: The dataset releases RGB sequences and pose references, not dense image-depth truth. The method internal patch depths are predictions.
note.zh: 数据集发布 RGB 序列和位姿参考，不提供稠密图像深度真值；方法内部图像块深度属于预测。

note.en: Agisoft Metashape SfM supplies pseudo-reference trajectories; independent measured metric scale is not established and evaluation uses Sim(3) alignment.
note.zh: Agisoft Metashape SfM 提供伪参考轨迹；未建立独立实测米制尺度，评测采用 Sim(3) 对齐。

note.en: Synthetic subsets have rendered depth. Real Pro depth is stereo-estimated, while the real X4 listing has no depth; real estimates are not measured depth truth.
note.zh: 合成子集有渲染深度；真实 Pro 深度来自立体估计，真实 X4 目录不含深度；真实估计不属于实测深度真值。

note.en: Synthetic trajectories and real OptiTrack reference poses are supplied. Real camera/mocap alignment is manual and uses mount-specific transforms.
note.zh: 提供合成轨迹与真实 OptiTrack 参考位姿；真实相机与动捕手动对齐，且需按安装方式应用变换。

note.en: Rendered ERP radial distance is supplied in metres with synthetic semantic labels; sky and far-plane masks remain task-specific.
note.zh: 提供米制渲染 ERP 径向距离及合成语义标签；天空和远平面掩码须按任务确定。

note.en: Simulator position and yaw are released per frame; pitch and roll are fixed to zero, so the motion is not arbitrary 6DoF.
note.zh: 逐帧发布仿真位置与偏航，俯仰、滚转固定为零，因此并非任意六自由度运动。

note.en: Public descriptions do not establish downloadable dense depth labels, formats or masks. RGB-D hardware or simulator naming alone is not proof of released depth truth.
note.zh: 公开描述尚未建立可下载的稠密深度标签、格式及掩码；RGB-D 硬件或仿真器名称不能证明已发布深度真值。

note.en: Real TCP references from logged robot kinematics and simulation states are announced; dataset and manifests remain pending release, so availability is unconfirmed.
note.zh: 已声明由机器人运动学日志生成真实 TCP 参考及仿真状态，但数据与清单仍待发布，可获取性尚未确认。

note.en: Room depth associations are confirmed for all three optics. Urban info archives list one depth association each; full urban frame coverage was not verified.
note.zh: Room 三种成像模型的深度关联已确认；Urban 信息归档每种仅列一条深度关联，尚未验证完整城市逐帧覆盖。

note.en: Simulator camera-to-world poses are supplied per image; associate frame IDs with image timestamps rather than reading IDs as seconds.
note.zh: 逐图像提供仿真相机到世界位姿；须将帧 ID 关联至图像时间戳，不可将 ID 当作秒。
